source.studyTitle: Deep learning-based decoding of axonal ultrastructure in gene-edited mice using electron microscopy imaging
source.biologicalContext: Mouse spinal-cord fibers in variably hypomyelinated gene-edited mouse models; source paper focuses on axon-myelin-ultrastructure analysis.
source.sourceModality: two-dimensional electron-microscopy images with semantic segmentation masks
source.citationLicense: The bioRxiv preprint is separately labeled CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; this audit does not copy manuscript images or text.

sampleRowPreview.pixelScale: not provided in the dataset viewer
sampleRowPreview.rowIdentifierScope: split-and-row-index only; no neuron, animal, section, or cell-object identifier is exposed

viewerLimitations: The public row viewer has image and label fields but no biological-object or serial-section identifier.
The 3964 by 3964 dimensions describe one preview row and are pixel dimensions, not physical units.
No longitudinal z-stack, voxel calibration, reconstructed neuron, or per-cell identity link is exposed in the dataset card or row viewer.

modelAndLicense.modelScope: semantic labels for abnormalities, mitochondria and periaxonal space; axon and myelin masks are supplied by an external segmentation tool in the documented pipeline
modelAndLicense.redistributionConditions: Non-commercial use, attribution, and same-or-compatible share-alike conditions for redistributed or modified dataset derivatives.
modelAndLicense.softwareLicense: GPLv3; separate from the dataset/model license.
modelAndLicense.distributionDecision: Link-only in this atlas. No image, mask, model weight, or derived segmentation is bundled.

identityAndGeometryBoundary.interpretation: A useful source reference for labeled two-dimensional axonal ultrastructure, not a 3D interneuron or a basis for assigning organelles to the selected cell.
